card.name: Word-start "se" in sea and seismic words
card.fires_on: The short piece "se" (or "SE") at the start of a word, mainly in sea words like seascapes, seashells, seagoing, and in seismic words like seismic and seismologist. It also fires on "SE" in SEVERE and SEVERAL.

modes.label: Sea compounds
modes.description: "se" begins a word about the sea, such as seascapes, seashells or seagoing.
modes.example: fame rested on his powerful depictions of boxing matches and gritty scenes of New York City's tenement life, but he also painted cityscapes,<< se>>ascapes, war scenes, and portraits

modes.label: Seismic words
modes.description: "se" begins seismic, seismology or seismologist in earthquake text.
modes.example: some structural damage on the east coast. Blake said this can be expected to happen every 25 to 30 years, but added that no<< se>>ismologist in the world can accurately predict

modes.label: Capital SE in severe/several
modes.description: Capitalized "SE" starts SEVERE or SEVERAL in all-caps label text.
modes.example: WARNINGS BECAUSE OF THE POSSIBILITY OF<< SE>>VERE TOXIC REACTIONS

card.writes: It pushes the model toward sea and marine words, such as ocean, marine and maritime.
card.plain: It spots the start of a word like seascape or seismic and nudges the model toward sea-related words.
